// Build registry map for fast O(1) lookup by register number
const configRegisterMap = {};
for (const item of configRegisterList) {
    configRegisterMap[item.reg] = item;
}

// Store registry and ordered list in flow context
flow.set("hp_config_registry", configRegisterMap);
flow.set("hp_config_list", configRegisterList);

// --- Logic ---
var configMessages = [];

// 1. Build Discovery Messages for Telemetry Sensors
for (const [jsonKey, config] of Object.entries(sensorMap)) {
    let component = config.component || "sensor"; 
    let safeId = jsonKey.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_').replace(/_+/g, '_'); 
    let uniqueId = `${deviceIdentifier}_${safeId}`;
    let objectId = `hp_${config.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_').replace(/_+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '')}`;
    let configTopic = `${discoveryPrefix}/${component}/${uniqueId}/config`;

    let payload = {
        "name": config.name,
        "unique_id": uniqueId,
        "object_id": objectId,
        "state_topic": stateTopic,
        "value_template": `{{ value_json['${jsonKey}'] }}`,
        "device": {
            "identifiers": [deviceIdentifier],
            "name": deviceName,
            "model": "Heat Pump Controller",
            "manufacturer": "Node-RED"
        }
    };

    if (component === "binary_sensor") {
        payload.payload_on = true;
        payload.payload_off = false;
        if (config.devClass) payload.device_class = config.devClass;
        if (config.icon) payload.icon = config.icon;
    } else {
        if (config.unit) {
            payload.state_class = "measurement";
            payload.unit_of_measurement = config.unit;
        }
        if (config.devClass) payload.device_class = config.devClass;
        if (config.icon) payload.icon = config.icon;
    }

    if (config.entityCategory) payload.entity_category = config.entityCategory;

    configMessages.push({
        topic: configTopic,
        payload: JSON.stringify(payload),
        retain: true
    });
}

// 2. Build Discovery Messages for Configuration Entities (switch, select, number)
// Covers all 109 registers: 21 Controls (Controls section) + 88 Configuration (Configuration section)
for (const config of configRegisterList) {
    let regNum = config.reg;
    let component = config.component || "number";
    let safeId = `reg_${regNum}_${config.key.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_').replace(/_+/g, '_')}`;
    let uniqueId = `${deviceIdentifier}_${safeId}`;
    let objectId = `hp_${config.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_').replace(/_+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '')}`;
    let configTopic = `${discoveryPrefix}/${component}/${uniqueId}/config`;
    let commandTopic = `${baseTopic}/${deviceIdentifier}/config/${regNum}/set`;

    let payload = {
        "name": config.name,
        "unique_id": uniqueId,
        "object_id": objectId,
        "state_topic": configStateTopic,
        "command_topic": commandTopic,
        "device": {
            "identifiers": [deviceIdentifier],
            "name": deviceName,
            "model": "Heat Pump Controller",
            "manufacturer": "Node-RED"
        }
    };

    if (config.icon) payload.icon = config.icon;
    if (config.entityCategory) payload.entity_category = config.entityCategory;

    if (component === "switch") {
        payload.payload_on = "ON";
        payload.payload_off = "OFF";
        payload.state_on = "ON";
        payload.state_off = "OFF";
        payload.value_template = `{{ 'ON' if value_json['${config.key}'] == 1 or value_json['${config.key}'] == 'ON' else 'OFF' }}`;
    } else if (component === "select") {
        payload.options = config.options || [];
        payload.value_template = `{{ value_json['${config.key}_name'] }}`;
    } else {
        // number component
        payload.value_template = `{{ value_json['${config.key}'] }}`;
        if (config.unit) payload.unit_of_measurement = config.unit;
        if (config.devClass) payload.device_class = config.devClass;
        if (config.min !== undefined) payload.min = config.min;
        if (config.max !== undefined) payload.max = config.max;
        if (config.step !== undefined) payload.step = config.step;
        if (config.mode) payload.mode = config.mode;
    }

    configMessages.push({
        topic: configTopic,
        payload: JSON.stringify(payload),
        retain: true
    });
}

// Clean up removed / obsolete discovery topics from Home Assistant
const obsoleteDiscoveryTopics = [
    `${discoveryPrefix}/binary_sensor/${deviceIdentifier}_high_pressure_switch_s01_/config`,
    `${discoveryPrefix}/binary_sensor/${deviceIdentifier}_low_pressure_switch_s02_/config`,
    `${discoveryPrefix}/binary_sensor/${deviceIdentifier}_water_flow_switch_s03_/config`,
    `${discoveryPrefix}/binary_sensor/${deviceIdentifier}_emergency_switch_s04_/config`,
    `${discoveryPrefix}/binary_sensor/${deviceIdentifier}_heater_overload_switch_s07_/config`,
    `${discoveryPrefix}/binary_sensor/${deviceIdentifier}_reserved_s06_/config`,
    `${discoveryPrefix}/binary_sensor/${deviceIdentifier}_reserved_s08_/config`
];
for (const topic of obsoleteDiscoveryTopics) {
    configMessages.push({
        topic: topic,
        payload: "",
        retain: true
    });
}

return [configMessages];

name: === LCD EMULATION & CONFIG MODIFIER ===
info:
Tato sekce obsahuje:
1. Emulaci LCD displeje (Slave 1) pro komunikaci s Masterem.
2. Automatické vyčtení všech parametrů při startu Node-RED:
   - Po startu Node-RED se automaticky nastaví Flag 128 (0x8000).
   - Master postupně zapíše všech 270 registrů (Block 1, 2 i 3).
   - Hodnoty se uloží do paměti flow contextu a slouží jako základ pro další úpravy.
3. Bezpečnostní pojistka:
   - Dokud neproběhne inicializace přes Flag 128, úpravy parametrů (Flag 2, 4, 8) jsou BLOKOVÁNY.
4. Správce konfigurace:
   - Block 1: 90 registrů 1001-1090 -> FLAG 2
   - Block 2: 90 registrů 1091-1180 -> FLAG 4
   - Block 3: 90 registrů 1181-1270 -> FLAG 8
5. Příklady úpravy parametrů přes inject nody a zobrazení stavu.
